title: Digital Quality Strategy Delivery Lead - Pharma Technical Operations

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint. PTE is the organization that catalyzes global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients. We aim to activate data citizenship and digital mindset, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem and systems landscape, re-design excellent processes, and generate transformative insights. The Opportunity You will be responsible for driving the digital technology strategy through the delivery of key digital initiatives and use cases in the Quality domain and you take the role of an Agile Product Owner (PO) to partner with customers across PT functions to architect the planning (e.g. diagnose), execution (e.g. design & build), and sustainment of digital solutions to achieve the PT Digital Aspirations.
• Strategic Digital Transformation: Architecting key initiatives and acting as a digital translator between business needs and technical roles by navigating across both domains seamlessly.
• Impact: Defining impact aspirations (e.g. product vision, roadmap, value assessments, business cases) as well as leading deployment of a global solution in a function or site. Enable significant improvements in quality management processes through innovative digital solutions, confirmed through the measurement of key business metrics.
• Requirements Analysis: Utilize your broad Quality end to end Business understanding to perform detailed requirement analyses with the team, with a strong focus on balancing process requirements, stakeholder requirements with digital product simplicity, network scalability and sustainability.
• Prioritization and Team Setup: Conducting use case prioritization and assuming the product owner role to catalyze the implementation of key digital use cases. Coach teams that are developing and deploying digital use cases, e.g. share best practices, agile ways of working, backlog management, sprint planning and ensure full impact capture & coordination between different initiatives. Lead cross-functional project teams with digital experts and SMEs across multiple sites and time zones.
• Compliance and Solution Shaping: Facilitating compliant solutions for data and digital products in the GxP environment.
• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify potential risks associated with digital quality initiatives and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.
• Innovation and Improvement: Continuously explore and assess emerging digital technologies and industry trends. Drive innovation and process improvements within the Quality domain to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Who you are You bring several years of experience in architecting and implementing digital
